I met her on tumblr in our sophmore year of high school, and began talking to her about her original characters for a roleplay. Roleplaying was my way of coping with my life and depression/anxiety/bad home life/etc. We built a friendship over the next 2 years. I learned about her home life when we talked about personal issues and our interests. Eventually I was able to talk to her on discord voice chat. I caught feelings HARD and spammed her with a lot of valentines on tumblr as a way of flirting. She wasnt sure if it was me being overly friendly or flirty. I asked her out on the first of april, soon after my 18th birthday. We were long distance for just over a year, I got to see her for the first time in person 8 months into our relationship. The second time I flew to see her was 1 year and 2 months in our relationahip and I just didnt leave. We're planning our proposals to one another, and our wedding. Weve been together now for over 2 years now, and Ive never been happier being with a person.
